These wavy, pale to brown lesions with irregular margins running along the leaf length are characteristic of Stewart's wilt bacterial infection, which causes pale green to yellow streaking that turns necrotic. The pattern differs from Northern corn leaf blight (which has larger cigar-shaped lesions), Gray leaf spot (more rectangular lesions), and Goss's wilt (which typically shows freckles/bacterial exudate).
